title: Batch absorption of Urm1-Flag conjugates from Drosophila tissues for mass spectrometry analysis
author: Caroline Grabbe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jizckf6

steps.title: Grow transgenic flies
steps.instruction: Maintain flies carrying UAS/GAL4 constructs at 25 °C until sufficient numbers are obtained.

steps.title: Collect and lyse embryos
steps.instruction: Harvest 0–22 h embryos, dechorinate in a 1:1 mixture of 14 % sodium hypochlorite (f.c. 7 %) and deionized H₂O for 2–4 min, rinse 1 min in deionized water, transfer 100 µL portions to 1.5 mL microtubes, mince with a pestle in 200 µL Lysis Buffer A (50 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1 mM EGTA, 1 % Triton X‑100, 10 % glycerol, 25 mM N‑ethylmaleimide (NAF), 10 µM ZnCl₂) supplemented with 1 tablet Complete Inhibitors (Roche) per 50 mL, 1 mM PMSF and 10 mM N‑ethyl‑maleimide (NEM), add 800 µL fresh Lysis Buffer A, continue grinding, incubate on ice 30 min, centrifuge 14 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, pool supernatants, measure protein concentration.

steps.title: Collect and lyse larvae
steps.instruction: Gather wandering third‑instar larvae, rinse twice in 1× PBS, place 25 larvae with 125 µL Lysis Buffer A in a 1.5 mL tube, grind with a pestle, add 375 µL fresh Lysis Buffer A, continue grinding, incubate on ice 30 min, centrifuge 14 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, pool supernatants, determine protein concentration.

steps.title: Collect and lyse adult flies
steps.instruction: Collect 0–4‑day‑old adult flies (40 per 1.5 mL tube) under CO₂ anesthesia, grind in 200 µL Lysis Buffer A, add another 200 µL Lysis Buffer A, continue grinding, incubate on ice 30 min, centrifuge 14 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, pool supernatants, measure protein concentration.

steps.title: Prepare input sample
steps.instruction: Mix 60 µL of each lysate with 60 µL 2× sample buffer, incubate 7 min at 98 °C; keep this as the INPUT sample.

steps.title: Wash and prepare Flag beads
steps.instruction: Defrost Flag M2 magnetic beads (Sigma M8823), aliquot slurry with a cut pipet tip, wash the beads three times with Lysis Buffer A, keep beads on a magnetic separator.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate Flag‑Urm1 conjugates
steps.instruction: In a 5 mL Falcon polypropylene tube (catalog 352063) combine 9 mg total protein in 4.5 mL volume with 150 µL bead slurry (≈75 µL packed beads), incubate 2 h at 4 °C on a rotator, collect beads magnetically and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash immunoprecipitated beads
steps.instruction: Wash beads four times with ~4 mL Lysis Buffer A (magnetic separation between washes), then wash twice with 4 mL Flag M2 rinsing buffer (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM CaCl₂). Retain a small volume of buffer for shipment, seal with Parafilm, keep on wet ice at 4 °C until transport to the mass‑spectrometry facility.

steps.title: On‑bead digestion and LC‑MS/MS
steps.instruction: Digest the bead‑bound proteins on‑bead with trypsin (as per facility protocol), inject the resulting peptides onto an Ultimate™ 3000 RSLCnano chromatography system coupled to a Q Exactive Plus Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific). Separate peptides on a homemade C18 column (25 cm, silica tip 360 µm OD, 75 µm ID, New Objective) at a flow rate of 300 nL/min using a 60‑min gradient: 5–26 % buffer B (2 % acetonitrile, 0.1 % formic acid) over 120 min, then increase to 95 % buffer B in 5 min. Analyze the data with standard bioinformatics methods.
